freeze_rule: Do not edit. Content generation reads this file only. Any curriculum change produces curriculum_master_v2.

prototype_policy.note: Working choices below exist so the prototype can be built. They are NOT settled curriculum policy and must not be presented as official.

X_G1_NUMBER_RANGE.generation_rule: Grade 1 numeral reading/writing content uses 0-20 only.

X_G1_COUNT_RANGE.working_choice: Grade 1 object counting up to 20 for generated items; groups-of-ten counting to 99 allowed only as oral/concrete 'bundle' activities
X_G1_COUNT_RANGE.basis: Conservative intersection of NCERT_LO (99) and NIPUN slide (20)
X_G1_COUNT_RANGE.generation_rule: Printed/visual counting sets in Grade 1 content contain at most 20 objects.

X_G1_ADDSUB_RANGE.working_choice: Grade 1 addition with sums up to 18; subtraction within 9; concrete/pictorial contexts
X_G1_ADDSUB_RANGE.generation_rule: No Grade 1 sums above 18; no subtraction from numbers above 9.

X_G2_WPM.basis: Sources conflict; NIPUN Bharat Guidelines not supplied
X_G2_WPM.generation_rule: Do not generate WPM-based or timed-reading assessment.

X_G2_TABLES.working_choice: Multiplication as repeated addition / skip counting only
X_G2_TABLES.generation_rule: No multiplication-table drills in Grade 2 content.

X_L2_TRACKS.working_choice: L2 is not a prototype focus
X_L2_TRACKS.generation_rule: Blueprints use L1 and language-neutral items only; no L2 English/L2 generic seeds.

generation_exclusions.rule: No Grade 1-2 fraction lessons; 'half' vocabulary (Vidya Pravesh IL3.26) is the only supported material.
No Grade 1-2 clock-reading or calendar-date content (supported only by the Grade 3 Lakshya).
No Grade 1-2 paragraph-writing tasks; writing stays at words, sentences and short descriptions.
No WPM or timed fluency scoring.
Out of scope (already excluded from the master).

review_gates.rule: Hindi outcome text and any generated Hindi content must be checked by a Hindi-literate reviewer before publishing.
Santali (sat) content, including script choice, must be checked by a Santali-literate reviewer before publishing.
Content generated under a provisional range must carry the conflict ID and be regenerated if the decision changes.

precedence_rules: Grade placement and outcome wording follow the highest-ranked source that states the outcome for that grade.
Lower-ranked statements that agree are kept as supporting provenance; ones that disagree are kept under provenance.overruled_by_precedence and listed in conflicts_to_review.json.

Parallel language tracks (L1 Hindi exemplar, L2 English) are not treated as duplicates of each other.
